p = '/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/docs/php/streams.md'
s = open(p).read()
old = "| `compress.zlib://` | Read-only wrapper that opens the underlying file and applies `zlib.inflate`. |"
new = ("| `compress.zlib://` | Opens the underlying file and applies `zlib.inflate` when reading or "
       "`zlib.deflate` when writing, so `fopen(\"compress.zlib://out.gz\", \"w\")` compresses. The URL may "
       "be a literal or built at run time — both reach the wrapper and produce the same bytes. |")
assert old in s, "compress.zlib doc row not found"
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("doc updated")
